newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR MON.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR MON.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it had set a tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS statement said that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector has a liquidity surplus ahead of a new minimum reserve period with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 104.27 percent as of Sunday, after 103.14 percent the previous day.
In the NBS's last reverse repo tender for a seven-day maturity on Friday, the average rate was 14.60 percent, after 14.95 percent the previous reverse repo tender with a similar maturity.
